def build_module_stubs(entries: Iterable[FunctionDefinition]) ->Dict[str,
    ModuleStub]:
    # Group entries by module
    modules: DefaultDict[str, List[FunctionDefinition]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for entry in entries:
        modules[entry.module].append(entry)
    
    result: Dict[str, ModuleStub] = {}
    
    for module_name, definitions in modules.items():
        function_stubs: List[FunctionStub] = []
        class_stubs: List[ClassStub] = []
        all_typed_dict_stubs: List[ClassStub] = []
        imports = ImportMap()
        
        # Group definitions by class (for class methods) vs module-level
        classes: DefaultDict[str, List[FunctionDefinition]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
        module_functions: List[FunctionDefinition] = []
        
        for defn in definitions:
            # Check if this is a class method/instance method
            if "." in defn.qualname:
                class_name = defn.qualname.split(".")[0]
                classes[class_name].append(defn)
            else:
                module_functions.append(defn)
        
        # Process module-level functions
        for defn in module_functions:
            stub = FunctionStub(
                defn.qualname,
                defn.signature,
                defn.kind,
                is_async=defn.is_async
            )
            function_stubs.append(stub)
            imports.merge(get_imports_for_signature(defn.signature))
            all_typed_dict_stubs.extend(defn.typed_dict_class_stubs)
        
        # Process class methods
        for class_name, class_defs in classes.items():
            class_function_stubs: List[FunctionStub] = []
            for defn in class_defs:
                # Extract just the method name from qualname
                method_name = defn.qualname.split(".")[-1]
                stub = FunctionStub(
                    method_name,
                    defn.signature,
                    defn.kind,
                    is_async=defn.is_async
                )
                class_function_stubs.append(stub)
                imports.merge(get_imports_for_signature(defn.signature))
                all_typed_dict_stubs.extend(defn.typed_dict_class_stubs)
            
            class_stub = ClassStub(class_name, function_stubs=class_function_stubs)
            class_stubs.append(class_stub)
        
        # Create the module stub
        module_stub = ModuleStub(
            function_stubs=function_stubs,
            class_stubs=class_stubs,
            imports_stub=ImportBlockStub(imports),
            typed_dict_class_stubs=all_typed_dict_stubs
        )
        result[module_name] = module_stub
    
    return result
